# The water band under the garden. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Deep --base-color 0.188 0.376 0.510 --no-slot
material new Ripple --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Ripple base-color ../level/textures/ripples.png
material new Pad --base-color 0.216 0.580 0.431 --no-slot
add mesh grid --x-subdivisions 1 --y-subdivisions 1 --size 1 --name Front --location 0 -0.75 -2.3
scale 19.2 2.8 1
apply --scale
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
apply --location
material assign Deep
add mesh grid --x-subdivisions 4 --y-subdivisions 1 --size 1 --name Top --location 0 0.45 -0.9
scale 19.2 2.4 1
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Ripple
active Top
mode edit
select all
uv cube-project --size 4.8 --center 0 0 0
mode object
add mesh cylinder --vertices 8 --radius 0.32 --depth 0.04 --name Pad0 --location -5.90 -0.5 -0.88
scale 1 0.6 1
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Pad
add mesh cylinder --vertices 8 --radius 0.32 --depth 0.04 --name Pad1 --location -1.10 -0.5 -0.88
scale 1 0.6 1
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Pad
add mesh cylinder --vertices 8 --radius 0.32 --depth 0.04 --name Pad2 --location 3.70 -0.5 -0.88
scale 1 0.6 1
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Pad
add mesh cylinder --vertices 8 --radius 0.32 --depth 0.04 --name Pad3 --location 8.50 -0.5 -0.88
scale 1 0.6 1
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Pad
select Top Front Pad0 Pad1 Pad2 Pad3
active Top
join
rename Top Water
select all
shade flat
export water.glb
